title: Tabs
description: Tabs make it easy to explore and switch between different views.

examples.name: Basic
Disabled
Centered
Icon
examples.description: The Tab with Icon. `icon` also accepts a bare `<svg>` element from a third-party icon library, which stays vertically centred with the label.

examples.name: Indicator
examples.description: Set `indicator` prop to custom indicator size and align.

examples.name: Slide
examples.description: In order to fit in more tabs, they can slide left and right (or up and down).

examples.name: Extra content
examples.description: You can add extra actions to the right or left or even both side of Tabs.

examples.name: Size
examples.description: Large size tabs are usually used in page header, and small size could be used in Modal.

examples.name: Placement
examples.description: Tab's placement: start, end, top or bottom. Will auto switch to `top` in mobile.

examples.name: Custom Popup Search
examples.description: Customize the Tabs more dropdown menu via `popupRender` prop, supporting search and keyboard navigation.

examples.name: Card type tab
examples.description: Another type of Tabs, which doesn't support vertical mode.

examples.name: Add & close tab
examples.description: Only card type Tabs support adding & closable. +Use `closable={false}` to disable close.

examples.name: Customized trigger of new tab
examples.description: Hide default plus icon, and bind event for customized trigger.

examples.name: Customized bar of tab
Draggable Tabs
examples.description: Use dnd-kit to make tabs draggable.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Tabs by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
